A '''scout''' was a [[Mandalorian]] that was loyal to [[Bo-Katan Kryze]].<ref name="Chapter 23" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Mandalorian scout first appeared in "[[Chapter 23: The Spies]]," the seventh episode of [[The Mandalorian Season Three|season three]] of the [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]'' which was released on [[April 12]], [[2023]].<ref name="S3 Dates">{{Twitter|starwars|status/1598416900689743873|[[Star Wars]]|date=2022-12-1|quote=The Mandalorian and Grogu return March 1 only on @DisneyPlus.|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/ytQHE}}</ref> The scout was portrayed by actor [[Charles Baker]].<ref name="Chapter 23" />
